response.sql: WITH per_id AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID HAVING AVG(ANA) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS mean_avg FROM per_id) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_ana, p.avg_ana - o.mean_avg AS gap_above_mean FROM per_id p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_ana > o.mean_avg ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
